entities.name: Oratorio del Gonfalone
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Oratorio del Gonfalone or Oratory of the Banner is a building in Central Rome which once housed a Catholic fraternity. Since about 1960 it has served as a concert venue for the Roman Polyphonic Choir.
